children: Hospitality chain Grand Continent Hotels has announced the launch of its 32nd hotel - Grand Continent Premier Vellore.
The new 50-room hotel has been designed to cater to business travellers, medical tourists, students and their families, leisure travellers and pilgrimage groups visiting Vellore.

“With the launch of our 32nd property, we are further strengthening our presence in South India while continuing to expand into markets where we see sustained demand. Our focus remains on building a well-connected portfolio across business, healthcare, pilgrimage and leisure destinations, while maintaining consistency in service and guest experience,” Ramesh Siva, Founder & Managing Director, Grand Continent Hotels Limited, said.
With the addition of the Vellore property, Grand Continent Hotels has expanded its presence to 32 hotels across 20 cities with more than 2,000 keys.
The company’s portfolio includes destinations such as Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Gurgaon, Hosur and Secunderabad.

title: Grand Continent Hotels launches new hotel at Vellore
